theorem aeval_unique (φ : MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] S₁) : φ = aeval (φ ∘ X) := by
  ext i
  simp

def aeval : MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] S₁ :=
  { eval₂Hom (algebraMap R S₁) f with commutes' := fun _r => eval₂_C _ _ _ }
